tagline: Digital art, original canvas paintings and live event painting.
description: Art by Jyxdi offers digital artwork, original canvas paintings, custom commissions and live painting for weddings, birthdays and other events.
bio: Jyxdi is an artist working across digital illustration and paint on canvas.
Alongside finished pieces and custom commissions, Jyxdi paints live at weddings, birthdays and other events, capturing the day on canvas as it happens.
